Question B-001-013-004.

Why the correct answer is right: At the beginning of communications, each amateur station must transmit its own call sign.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "No identification is required": No identification would leave the stations unaccountable at the start of the contact.
- sourceIndex 2: "Both stations must transmit both call signs": Both stations saying both call signs is not required; each station identifies itself.
- sourceIndex 3: "One of the stations must give both stations' call signs": One station cannot satisfy the rule for both by being the only one to speak both call signs.
